song-own-machine.prompt: upbeat indie pop, jangly electric guitars, tight live drums, warm bass, bright female lead vocal, catchy singalong chorus, major key, 118 BPM
song-own-machine.lyrics:
[verse]
Typed a little sentence, then I hit the key
Out came a thunderstorm, just for me
No meter ticking, no cloud in the sky
It's all running here on my own machine tonight

[chorus]
Play it again, play it loud
Nobody's watching, nobody's around
Every sound I dreamed up
Came right out of the speakers now

voice-intro.text: Describe a sound, and get a file on your disk. Write some lyrics and get a song. Clone a voice from a short clip. It all runs on your own machine, with no account and no credits.
